versions.summary: Starter sheet refinements for publication header, total pages, and format-specific field adjustments

items: Added an auto-populated Total Pages field to the Standard, USAT, and NYT starter sheet formats.
Replaced the starter sheet title label on all three starter sheet formats with a full-width Publication box.
Updated the USAT starter sheet so the First Image box matches the Last Image box size and is positioned directly below it on the left side.
Removed the NYT CLOSE DETAILS header line from the NYT starter sheet format.

versions.summary: All new starter sheets for all 3 formats

items: Added all new starter sheet layouts for the Standard, USAT, and NYT formats.

versions.summary: Headless preview regeneration for launcher and cleanup tools

items: Added a direct preview regeneration helper that rebuilds .preview.png files from saved JSON data without opening a layout editor window.
Updated the main launcher, template editor, regular editor, and Cleanup Layouts dialog to use headless preview regeneration for manual and bulk preview rebuilds.
Removed obsolete temporary-window preview regeneration code paths from the UI build where they were no longer needed.
Fixed preview regeneration actions that still flashed a layout editor window when rebuilding individual previews or regenerating all previews from the cleanup tool.

versions.summary: Adjusted font for printed layout to improve readability

items: Adjusted the font used in the printed layout to improve readability and ensure that all text is clear and legible when printed.

versions.summary: Fix layout issues in printed output

items: Resolved an issue where the layout of the printed output was not displaying correctly.

versions.summary: Add legend and color page list to printed layout

items: Added a legend to the printed layout to provide context for the page list.
Added a color page list to the printed layout.
Updated the layout of the printed output to accommodate the new legend and color page list.
Improved the styling of the printed layout for better readability.

versions.summary: Press and format conversions in layout editor

items: Press and format conversions in layout editor.
Fixed a bug where change tracking in the layout editor was not working correctly causing the save changes dialog to trigger even when no changes were made.

versions.summary: Fixed page count calculation in layout editor

items: Corrected the page count calculation in the layout editor.

versions.summary: Changes New Layout window to a treeview with filters

items: The New Layout window now uses a treeview to display available layouts, allowing for better organization and easier navigation.
Added filter options to the New Layout window, enabling users to quickly find specific templates and layouts.
Layout editor now calculates the page counts for the sections automatically.

versions.summary: Adds launcher version loading from changelog.json and a clickable changelog history view.

items: The main launcher now pulls its version number from changelog.json.
Clicking the version label opens the changelog history dialog.
Updated changelog storage to keep multiple versions in one file.
Added a compact changelog view with collapsible version sections.

versions.summary: Initial release of the Press Layout launcher.

items: Initial consolidated launcher UI for Press Layouts.
Layout browsing, filtering, and preview support.
